about.en: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. is a Japanese financial holding company whose group companies include MUFG Bank, Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking and Mitsubishi UFJ Securities Holdings. MUFG represents its American depositary shares listed on the NYSE, each equal to one common share, distinct from the common shares listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange as 8306 (catalogued as mitsubishi-ufj-financial-group).
